kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نجلوذ (form XIII)
# نَجْلَوِّذُ (najlawwiḏu) /nad͡ʒ.law.wi.ðu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
# نَجْلَوِّذَ (najlawwiḏa) /nad͡ʒ.law.wi.ða/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
# نَجْلَوِّذْ (najlawwiḏ) /nad͡ʒ.law.wið/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
